questions.explanation: 上下文提到“helping with tasks...”，说明作者在“帮助”同事做实验。aid 意为“帮助，援助”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(graded)：语境句：The teacher graded the exams quickly. 固定搭配：grade papers, grade tests
B(aided)：语境句：The organization aided the victims of the earthquake. 固定搭配：aid sb in doing sth, first aid
C(funded)：语境句：The government funded the new research project. 固定搭配：fund a project, fully funded
D(scheduled)：语境句：The meeting is scheduled for Monday. 固定搭配：schedule a meeting, ahead of schedule

questions.explanation: 安排紧凑的时间表需要“应付/管理”。manage a tight schedule 意为“管理紧凑的日程”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(assign)：语境句：The teacher will assign homework every Friday. 固定搭配：assign tasks, assign sb to do
B(manage)：语境句：She knows how to manage her time effectively. 固定搭配：manage a schedule, manage to do
C(delay)：语境句：The flight was delayed due to bad weather. 固定搭配：delay doing sth, without delay
D(decline)：语境句：He politely declined the invitation to the party. 固定搭配：decline an offer, in decline

questions.explanation: 作者最初认为能应付紧凑的日程是自己“能力”的体现。competence 意为“能力，胜任”，符合语境逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(patience)：语境句：Teaching young children requires a lot of patience. 固定搭配：have patience with, lose patience
B(competence)：语境句：The manager praised her professional competence. 固定搭配：core competence, demonstrate competence
C(knowledge)：语境句：Reading books expands our knowledge of the world. 固定搭配：acquire knowledge, common knowledge
D(ambition)：语境句：His ambition is to become a successful entrepreneur. 固定搭配：achieve one's ambition, full of ambition

questions.explanation: 破折号后解释“无法在所有任务中投入最好的状态”，说明注意力被“分散”了。divided 意为“分散的，分裂的”。
questions.supplement:
A(drawn)：语境句：His attention was drawn to the loud noise outside. 固定搭配：draw attention to, be drawn to
B(focused)：语境句：Stay focused on your goals to achieve success. 固定搭配：focus on, stay focused
C(divided)：语境句：The committee was divided on the new policy. 固定搭配：divide into, divided attention
D(directed)：语境句：The police officer directed the traffic at the intersection. 固定搭配：direct attention to, direct a film

questions.explanation: 呼应第一段的“tasks like data analysis”，指代前文提到的各种工作“任务”。
questions.supplement:
A(achievements)：语境句：We are proud of her academic achievements. 固定搭配：make achievements, outstanding achievements
B(courses)：语境句：I signed up for two elective courses this semester. 固定搭配：take a course, online courses
C(rewards)：语境句：Hard work will eventually bring great rewards. 固定搭配：reap the rewards, financial rewards
D(tasks)：语境句：He completed all his daily tasks before leaving the office. 固定搭配：accomplish a task, assign tasks

questions.explanation: 同事对作者说“你需要重新评估工作方式”，这是一种“建议”。suggest 意为“建议”。
questions.supplement:
A(ordered)：语境句：The commander ordered the soldiers to advance. 固定搭配：order sb to do, place an order
B(blamed)：语境句：She blamed him for the failure of the project. 固定搭配：blame sb for sth, take the blame
C(suggested)：语境句：He suggested taking a walk after dinner. 固定搭配：suggest doing sth, strongly suggest
D(investigated)：语境句：The police investigated the cause of the fire. 固定搭配：investigate a case, thoroughly investigate

questions.explanation: 结合前文作者处于极度疲劳(burnt out)状态，同事建议作者“慢下来”。slow down 意为“放慢节奏”。
questions.supplement:
A(slow down)：语境句：You need to slow down and take a rest. 固定搭配：slow down the pace, slow down a bit
B(hang on)：语境句：Hang on a minute, I'll be right back. 固定搭配：hang on to, hang on a second
C(cheer up)：语境句：He bought her some flowers to cheer her up. 固定搭配：cheer up, cheer sb up
D(fight back)：语境句：It takes courage to fight back against bullying. 固定搭配：fight back tears, fight back against

questions.explanation: 为了划清工作界限，晚上作者会让工作手机保持“不被触碰/不用”的状态。untouched 意为“未触碰的”。
questions.supplement:
A(untouched)：语境句：The food on his plate remained untouched. 固定搭配：leave sth untouched, remain untouched
B(uncharged)：语境句：My phone died because it was left uncharged. 固定搭配：uncharged battery, remain uncharged
C(unpaid)：语境句：She took unpaid leave to care for her sick mother. 固定搭配：unpaid bills, unpaid work
D(unlocked)：语境句：Make sure not to leave the front door unlocked. 固定搭配：leave unlocked, an unlocked phone

questions.explanation: 作者开始在工作时间周围设定明确的“界限”。set boundaries 意为“设定界限”，符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(guidelines)：语境句：Please strictly follow the safety guidelines. 固定搭配：strict guidelines, draw up guidelines
B(deadlines)：语境句：We have to work overtime to meet the deadlines. 固定搭配：meet a deadline, miss a deadline
C(goals)：语境句：Setting clear goals is essential for success. 固定搭配：achieve a goal, set goals
D(boundaries)：语境句：It is important to set healthy boundaries in a relationship. 固定搭配：set boundaries, push the boundaries

questions.explanation: 作者对承担的项目变得更加“有选择性”，不再什么工作都接。selective 意为“有选择性的，挑剔的”。
questions.supplement:
A(selective)：语境句：Universities are highly selective when admitting students. 固定搭配：be selective about, highly selective
B(curious)：语境句：Children are naturally curious about the world. 固定搭配：be curious about, out of curiosity
C(confident)：语境句：She feels confident about passing the driving test. 固定搭配：be confident in/about, highly confident
D(anxious)：语境句：He was anxious about the outcome of the interview. 固定搭配：be anxious about, feel anxious

questions.explanation: 起初作者觉得做得比别人少，担心这种选择会“影响”自己的职业生涯。affect 意为“影响”。
questions.supplement:
A(launch)：语境句：The company plans to launch a new product next month. 固定搭配：launch a product, launch an attack
B(improve)：语境句：Regular exercise can improve your physical health. 固定搭配：improve significantly, room for improvement
C(affect)：语境句：Lack of sleep will negatively affect your performance. 固定搭配：greatly affect, affect the outcome
D(lengthen)：语境句：Stretching exercises help to lengthen your muscles. 固定搭配：lengthen the lifespan, lengthen significantly

questions.explanation: 随着作者花更多时间“喘息/放松”和反思，事情变得清晰。breathe 此处引申为“放松，喘息”。
questions.supplement:
A(research)：语境句：Scientists continue to research into the causes of the disease. 固定搭配：do research on, scientific research
B(experiment)：语境句：They decided to experiment with a new teaching method. 固定搭配：experiment with, do an experiment
C(breathe)：语境句：Take a moment to step outside and breathe deeply. 固定搭配：breathe deeply, breathe life into
D(battle)：语境句：The doctors are battling to save the patient's life. 固定搭配：battle against, an uphill battle

questions.explanation: 后文提到“我意识到自己真的很喜欢培训学生……”，这是上文“优先事项变得清晰”的具体例子。For instance 意为“例如”。
questions.supplement:
A(For instance)：语境句：There are many healthy foods; for instance, apples and broccoli. 固定搭配：for instance, take... for instance
B(In addition)：语境句：In addition, the hotel offers a free breakfast. 固定搭配：in addition to, in addition
C(By contrast)：语境句：By contrast, the city's northern part is much wealthier. 固定搭配：by contrast, in contrast to
D(As always)：语境句：As always, he arrived exactly on time. 固定搭配：as always

questions.explanation: 最终，这种工作方式和心态上的“改变”使作者效率更高。change 意为“改变”。
questions.supplement:
A(belief)：语境句：She has a strong belief in the power of education. 固定搭配：beyond belief, strong belief
B(training)：语境句：The new employees are currently undergoing training. 固定搭配：provide training, physical training
C(purchase)：语境句：He made a significant purchase by buying a new car. 固定搭配：make a purchase, purchase online
D(change)：语境句：The change in weather caught everyone by surprise. 固定搭配：make a change, significant change

questions.explanation: 为自己创造空间（放慢节奏）并不是“落后”的标志，而是专注真正重要事物的方法。falling behind 意为“落后”。
questions.supplement:
A(showing off)：语境句：He drove his new sports car just to show off. 固定搭配：show off, a show-off
B(breaking down)：语境句：The car ended up breaking down in the middle of nowhere. 固定搭配：break down, mental breakdown
C(fading away)：语境句：As time went on, the memories started fading away. 固定搭配：fade away, fade into the background
D(falling behind)：语境句：If you miss too many classes, you risk falling behind. 固定搭配：fall behind schedule, fall behind in class

questions.explanation: "so + 助动词/be动词 + 主语" 结构表示“……也是如此”。主语是复数名词 breathtaking green landscapes，且根据前句 "the desert is here" 确定时态为一般现在时，故填 are。
questions.supplement: 正确形(are)：语境句：She is a doctor, and so are her parents. 固定搭配：so are we, there are。原词be其它变形：is(单数), was/were(过去式), been(过去分词), being(现在分词)。

questions.explanation: 所属格 AlUla's 后面需要接名词作主语。unique 的名词形式为 uniqueness，意为“独特性”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(uniqueness)：语境句：The uniqueness of this artwork makes it extremely valuable. 固定搭配：cultural uniqueness。原词unique其它变形：uniquely(adv.)。

questions.explanation: 考查固定连词搭配 both... and...，连接两个并列成分。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：The task is both challenging and rewarding. 固定搭配：both... and..., and so on。

questions.explanation: 考查固定时间状语表达 "earlier this year"，意为“今年早些时候”。句首首字母需大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(Earlier)：语境句：Earlier this year, the company launched a new product. 固定搭配：earlier than expected, much earlier。原词early其它变形：earliest(最高级)。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。主语 the tourism section 与 partner 之间是主动关系，表示“与……合作”，用现在分词 partnering 作伴随状语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(partnering)：语境句：The school is partnering with local companies to offer internships. 固定搭配：partner with, business partner。原词partner其它变形：partners(复数), partnered(过去式/过去分词)。

questions.explanation: fair 此处意为“展销会，博览会”，为可数名词。travel fair 表示“旅游博览会”，根据语境，参加的是泛指的多个博览会，故用复数形式 fairs。
questions.supplement: 正确形(fairs)：语境句：She traveled around the world to attend international trade fairs. 固定搭配：job fair, book fair。原词fair其它变形：fairly(adv.), fairness(n.)。

questions.explanation: 考查非限制性定语从句。先行词是 strategy，指物，在从句中作主语，故用关系代词 which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which)：语境句：He proposed a new strategy, which proved to be highly effective. 固定搭配：in which, of which。

questions.explanation: 考查介词。work with sb 意为“与某人合作”，此处指与中国博物馆合作。
questions.supplement: 正确形(with)：语境句：She works closely with a team of researchers. 固定搭配：work with, communicate with。

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。overview 为可数名词单数，表示“一个概述”，且以元音音素 /əʊ/ 开头，故用不定冠词 an。
questions.supplement: 正确形(an)：语境句：The manager gave us an overview of the company's financial status. 固定搭配：give an overview of, provide an overview。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。此处表示学习中文的目的是“使沟通顺畅”，用动词不定式作目的状语。smooth 此处作动词，意为“使平稳，使顺畅”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to smooth)：语境句：The new policy was introduced to smooth the transition process. 固定搭配：smooth the way for, smooth things over。原词smooth其它变形：smoothly(adv.), smoothness(n.), smoothed(过去式)。
